answer: Make each new identity post a stake bond that unlocks only after it earns attestations from established peers along a weighted trust thread. A sybil farm can mint names cheaply, but every raven it spawns needs its own locked bond and its own vouchers, and vouchers that keep backing junk lose their bond too. Clustered fakes look like one lagoon of mutual endorsements with almost no edges out, so the system discounts their weight and the attack costs real capital per head.
